rv.q: I can confirm that the recent Atlanta production has lost none of its power.
A quarter century on, there are still few productions that have so boldly embraced scale and experimentalism at the same time.

cn.t: Critics praise *The Lion King* for retaining its magic after 25 years, with its breathtaking scale, meticulous detail, and undeniable cultural impact creating a stunning theatrical experience that continues to transport audiences.
